learning_objective: 🎯 Take a vibrant journey through India to explore the beautiful stories, mudras, and costumes of Classical and Folk dances!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India has ancient Classical dances like Bharatanatyam, Kathak, and Odissi. These dances are like strict, beautiful schools of art where dancers train for years to tell old mythological stories.
Folk dances like Bhangra, Garba, and Bihu are full of energy and fun! They belong to everyday people who dance in circles and groups to celebrate harvests, weddings, and changing seasons.
In Indian dance, dancers use specific hand gestures called 'Mudras'. A simple change in your fingers can represent a blooming lotus flower, a flying bird, or a fierce lion!
Indian dance costumes are world-famous for their bright silks, heavy metallic jewelry, and musical ankle bells called 'Ghungroos' that add rhythm to every single footstep.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Master the Mudras
fun_activity.instructions: Learn two easy hand mudras: For 'Pataka' (flag), keep all your fingers straight and tight together. For 'Mayura' (peacock), touch your thumb to your ring finger while keeping the others straight. Try telling a quick story using just your hands!

quick_recap: ⭐ Classical dances follow ancient rules and tell spiritual stories from mythology.
⭐ Folk dances are energetic community dances that celebrate everyday life and nature.
⭐ Dancers use hand gestures called Mudras to represent animals, nature, and feelings.
⭐ Costumes, makeup, and Ghungroos (ankle bells) are very important parts of Indian dance performances.
